annotations.title: The Hydration Station: citable grounding snippets on a topic

description:
Returns citable reference snippets on a topic, formatted for RAG insertion with stable IDs and a source for each. Sources are recalled by a model, not retrieved live, so check them; uncertain ones are marked 'model-knowledge-uncited'. Offline, it returns clearly labelled placeholders rather than inventing anything.

A long, cool drink of grounding, from springs we can name.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

topic.description: The topic to fetch grounding snippets for.
